transport: same-origin EventSource; authenticated HttpOnly OWNER session; no bearer in URL
authority: transactional outbox after domain commit; uncommitted events prohibited
ordering: sequence scoped to stream; bigint encoded decimal string; server cursor bound to stream/filter digest
dedupe: eventId; replay does not animate twice
onGap: Pause animations, label stale, request snapshot with atomic snapshotCursor; replay only sequence > snapshotCursor; do not apply partial order
onExpiredCursor: HTTP 409 typed STREAM_CURSOR_EXPIRED; fetch authoritative snapshot and cursor
pollSemantics: snapshot polling after 3 failed connections; show last confirmed timestamp; no pulses in polling mode

animation.aggregation: Keep exact count, first/last cursor and drill-down; do not invent intermediate events; failure/warning never hidden
animation.reducedMotion: Static directional arrow + count + timestamp; no positional or flashing animation
animation.tabHidden: Suspend animation only, retain cursor; resync snapshot on return
animation.disconnect: Stop pulses immediately; keep last known objects visibly stale
